rows.responsibility: overflowing selectable text presentation with delayed wraparound marquee motion, DPR-aware tape/frame/fade caches, reduced-motion and visibility/window-activity gating, mouse/keyboard selection and copy, edge-scroll, outside-click selection teardown, context-menu copy projection, and StaticText accessibility
rows.state_machine: text/geometry/palette/selectable state -> overflow detection -> delayed marquee while visible+active+motion-enabled+unpaused -> interaction pause/selection/menu -> copy/edge-scroll/outside-dismiss -> hide/inactive/reduced-motion/teardown reset
rows.side_effects: Presentation and clipboard interaction only; authoritative conversation/product text remains in existing Fabushi state owners.
rows.failure_cases: marquee survives hidden/inactive/reduced-motion state; stale DPR/palette/text/geometry cache; wrapped offset maps selection to wrong symbol; edge-scroll exceeds bounds; outside-click filter or menu callback survives teardown; copy emits wrong selection/full text; accessible name is stale
rows.ui_disposition: Reuse source-neutral canonical text/Status, ContextMenu/Menu, clipboard capability, accessibility and reduced-motion lifecycle owners; do not introduce a Telegram-named marquee or second text state owner.
rows.fabushi_canonical_owner: canonical text presentation + ContextMenu/clipboard + accessibility/motion policy
rows.fabushi_target: mapped-open; shipping composition, focused lifecycle/a11y tests and same-head evidence required
rows.platform_differences: Qt paint caches, timers and event filters map to React/Electron text/motion/selection primitives while preserving visibility, focus, selection, cache invalidation and teardown semantics.
rows.production_evidence: Exact accepted blob read/decomposed only; production closure remains open.
rows.test_evidence: Focused reduced-motion, a11y, selection/copy, context-menu, stale-callback and teardown evidence plus exact-head GitHub Actions required before closure.
rows.reachability_status: accepted-tree exact blob responsibility proven; production closure open
rows.license_and_provenance: tdesktop provenance retained; source-neutral rewrite required.
rows.notes: Reading does not decrement global unknown.
